# Austin Barber / vicblurr

> Barbershop based in Austin, Texas. Victor specializes in precision shear work, blurry fades and beard work, on Webberville Rd in East Austin. Tell him what you are after and you walk out with exactly that.

- Phone: (512) 797-2705
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Del Valle, Manor, Pflugerville, Round Rock
- Booksy rating: 5.0 from 11 reviews

- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/barbershops/texas/austin-barber-vicblurr/book.html

## Services
- Haircuts & fades: Keep your cut clean and consistent: a fresh fade, cleanup and light shear work. 45 minutes, $45.
- Precision shear cuts: The P.S.C: detailed scissor work to reshape, take off length or refine your shape. 1 hour 15 minutes, $65.
- Beards & razor work: Beard and mustache shaping with sharp lines, plus straight razor work. Add a beard to any cut when you book.

## About
Victor Rafael is Austin born and raised, with 3+ years in the barber industry. He cuts at 2426 Webberville Rd, Unit A, in East Austin: a bright shop behind a red door, with ring lights at the stations and hex lights across the ceiling. His specialty is shear work and blurry fades, plus straight razor shaves and beard work. In his own words: sharp cuts, clean lines, no shortcuts. Clients keep saying the same things: great scissor work, honest advice on what suits your hair, clean cuts and a haircut exactly how you asked for it. Some come in alone, some bring their friends, and some just moved to Austin and needed a barber they could trust.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book with Victor?
  A: Book online through Victor's Booksy page, or call (512) 797-2705.
- Q: How much is a haircut?
  A: A haircut is $45 and a haircut + beard is $60. A Precision Shear Cut (P.S.C) is $65, or $80 with a beard. Prices are as listed on Booksy.
- Q: Haircut or P.S.C, which should I book?
  A: Book a Haircut to keep your current cut clean: a fresh fade, cleanup and light shear work. Book the P.S.C if you want reshaping, length taken off or detailed scissor work, especially if it has been 4+ weeks.
- Q: What are the hours?
  A: Monday 12 PM to 5 PM, Tuesday to Friday 10 AM to 7 PM and Saturday 10 AM to 5 PM. Closed Sunday. Holiday hours can differ, so check Booksy.
- Q: Where is the shop?
  A: 2426 Webberville Rd, Unit A, Austin, TX 78702, in East Austin. Look for the red door with the barber pole beside it. Parking is available.
- Q: Do you take cards?
  A: Yes, credit cards are accepted. Booksy also offers packages if you want to buy cuts in bulk.
